description:
Monitor host performance using OpenTelemetry Collector's hostmetrics receiver. Includes CPU utilization, system load, memory usage, disk I/O throughput/IOPS, filesystem utilization, and network traffic. Features flexible host label filtering for Kubernetes or standalone deployments.

Requirements: OpenTelemetry Collector with hostmetrics receiver (cpu, disk, load, filesystem, memory, network scrapers) exporting to Prometheus with UnderscoreEscapingWithSuffixes translation strategy.

panels.description: Non-reclaimable memory utilization: Linux used memory divided by physical memory limit. Cache and buffers are excluded from pressure.
panels.title: Memory Pressure

panels.description: Physical memory reported by the OpenTelemetry hostmetrics receiver. Do not derive total memory by summing overlapping usage states.
panels.title: Total Memory

panels.description: A non-overlapping stack that always equals physical RAM. Used is Linux memory pressure (MemTotal minus MemAvailable). Free and Buffered use their reported values. Cached is normalized to the remaining reclaimable/available memory so Cached + Buffered + Free equals Available.
panels.title: Memory Accounting

panels.description: Pressure-aware utilization based on Linux used memory (MemTotal minus MemAvailable). Reclaimable page cache and buffers do not count as used.
panels.title: Memory Pressure Over Time

title: Host Metrics (opentelemetry)
